title: Extend batch JSON with reusable assignments
description: Extend version-1 batch JSON rows with optional reusableTasks as an ordered array of definition names or UUIDs. Omission preserves assignments; null clears them; an array replaces them. Preserve strict unknown and duplicate property rejection, deterministic field order, stale updatedAt requirements, identifier validation, UTF-8, and all existing patch semantics. Decode into the core optional assignment input without resolving definitions in the codec. Export populated assignments deterministically using stable canonical UUIDs so round trips do not depend on later renames. Add codec tests for preserve/replace/reorder/clear, empty arrays, null, duplicates, invalid element types, unknown names deferred to provider validation, and old version-1 documents that omit the new field.
